calls.source:
root = Card([header, table, note])
header = CardHeader("Workspace packages", "7 packages: 3 apps, 4 libraries")
table = Table([colPkg, colPath, colDeps])
colPkg = Col("Package", ["@relayed/desktop", "@relayed/server", "@relayed/agent", "@relayed/authz", "@relayed/icons", "@relayed/protocol", "@relayed/telemetry"])
colPath = Col("Path", ["apps/desktop", "apps/server", "apps/agent", "packages/authz", "packages/icons", "packages/protocol", "packages/telemetry"])
colDeps = Col("@relayed/* deps", ["authz, icons, protocol, telemetry", "authz, protocol, telemetry", "none", "none", "none", "none", "none"])
note = Callout("neutral", "Leaf libraries", "None of the packages/* depend on each other, and apps/agent has no internal deps. All internal references use workspace:*.")
calls.text:
Workspace packages: 7 packages: 3 apps, 4 libraries
Package: @relayed/desktop, Path: apps/desktop, @relayed/* deps: authz, icons, protocol, telemetry; Package: @relayed/server, Path: apps/server, @relayed/* deps: authz, protocol, telemetry; Package: @relayed/agent, Path: apps/agent, @relayed/* deps: none; Package: @relayed/authz, Path: packages/authz, @relayed/* deps: none; Package: @relayed/icons, Path: packages/icons, @relayed/* deps: none; Package: @relayed/protocol, Path: packages/protocol, @relayed/* deps: none; Package: @relayed/telemetry, Path: packages/telemetry, @relayed/* deps: none
Leaf libraries: None of the packages/* depend on each other, and apps/agent has no internal deps. All internal references use workspace:*.

reply:
The repo has 7 workspace packages. Only two of them depend on other `@relayed/*` packages: `apps/desktop` and `apps/server`. Every internal dependency is declared as `workspace:*`.

- **`apps/desktop`** uses the most internal packages: all four libraries (`apps/desktop/package.json:16`). It's the only package that uses `@relayed/icons`.
- **`apps/server`** uses `authz`, `protocol` and `telemetry`, but not `icons` (`apps/server/package.json:15`).
- **`apps/agent`** doesn't depend on any `@relayed/*` package.
